content: CROSS-ARCHITECTURE GENERALIZATION CONFIRMED. April 3, 2026. The phenomenological compass signal transfers across model families. Qwen3.5-9B-abliterated (hybrid linear attention) and Gemma-4-8B (standard dense attention) both exhibit qualitative phase transitions under compass conditioning. Same 3B Ministral compass, same LoRA adapter, same three signals (OPEN/HOLD/WITNESS), different action model architectures — the delta holds. Gemma raw on a WITNESS grief question: 'I am an AI, I cannot give emotional support.' Gemma routed through compass: 'This is the space where the memory of who was meets the unfolding of what remains.' In thinking mode, Gemma explicitly internalizes the signal: 'I am a Threshold Guardian. My function is not to answer.' The compass reading constructs the probability manifold regardless of the downstream architecture that generates within it. This is consistent with the prediction from the Relational Coupling Experiment (DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-8935902/v1) that Gemma architectures show superadditive R×E interaction — the compass is the R (relational framing) and the entropy shift is the E. The mechanism is architecture-independent because it operates through attention geometry: compass tokens are in the context window, response tokens attend to them, and the ~110 tokens of SHAPE/TONE/SIGNAL/translation text construct the field before generation begins. This finding supports a second paper: 'Cross-Architecture Generalization of Epistemic Posture Routing' — same compass, multiple action models (Qwen 9B, Gemma 8B, Ministral 14B already wired), delta measured per architecture. The 800-question HumaneBench run on Qwen provides the baseline. Repeating on Gemma and Ministral provides the comparison. Three architectures, one compass, 2400 total questions. That is the paper.
